universal.title: Exact system and configuration boundary
universal.minimum_evidence: Resolve every material hardware, software, firmware, model, data-pipeline, accessory, service, procedure and supplier component, including effective dates and configuration relationships.
universal.closure_test: An exact configuration record and material-change rule exist; every evidence item and endpoint points to a configuration or epoch.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: No claim may transfer across unresolved versions or configurations.

universal.title: Function, directionality, population, context and actors
universal.minimum_evidence: State recording, inference, intervention, actuation and closed-loop functions, with intended and excluded populations, settings, operators, decision-makers and affected third parties.
universal.closure_test: All functions and actors are explicit and bounded to the assessed context.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: No capability or deployment inference outside the declared population and context.

universal.title: Claim and source-state register
universal.minimum_evidence: Preserve exact claimant, wording, source location, evidence state, version, strongest supported claim and prohibited inference for every material claim.
universal.closure_test: Every material claim has a source-state and bounded adjudication.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: No publication, authorization, company statement or media claim may substitute for another evidence state.

universal.title: Endpoint, denominator, comparator and observation control
universal.minimum_evidence: Define endpoint, metric direction, aggregation level, denominator, comparator, observation period, uncertainty and protocol/version state.
universal.closure_test: Each numerical claim can be reconstructed from an exact endpoint and denominator.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: No best-case, completer, post-hoc or participant-rated result may be presented as a population-wide primary endpoint.

universal.title: Reproducibility and replay boundary
universal.minimum_evidence: State which layers can be independently reproduced: analysis, endpoint, model, online system, clinical workflow and deployment.
universal.closure_test: Reproduction level, unavailable inputs and replay acceptance criteria are explicit.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Public code or figures alone do not establish system reproduction.

universal.title: Rights, autonomy, consent and cessation
universal.minimum_evidence: Document voluntariness, dynamic consent, withdrawal, user control, cessation, support needs and non-waivable rights.
universal.closure_test: Participant authority and withdrawal consequences are operationally specified.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Initial consent cannot authorize unlimited secondary use or eliminate continuing rights.

universal.title: Multidimensional safety, burden and proportionality
universal.minimum_evidence: Record physical, psychological, cognitive, social, operational, caregiver and infrastructure burdens, alternatives, safety events, longitudinal follow-up and stop rules.
universal.closure_test: A denominator-linked event ledger and benefit-risk decision exist for the exact scope.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Capability continuity or authorization cannot substitute for safety adjudication.

universal.title: Neural-data taxonomy and governance
universal.minimum_evidence: Classify raw neural data, features, labels, inferences, logs, derived models and linked personal data; specify purpose, minimization, access, participant rights, reuse and cross-border governance.
universal.closure_test: Access, retention, reuse, withdrawal and repository controls are evidenced.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: A privacy mode or de-identification statement alone does not establish complete downstream control.

universal.title: Cybersecurity, update and resilience dossier
universal.minimum_evidence: Provide threat model, secure-development baseline, vulnerability testing, update/rollback/recovery, incident forensics and supplier-cessation plan.
universal.closure_test: Independent security evidence covers the exact configuration and operating environment.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Absence of public incidents does not establish security.

universal.title: AI and algorithmic assurance
universal.minimum_evidence: Document model and training provenance, signal-versus-prior contribution, calibration, abstention, robustness, human oversight, bias and representativeness.
universal.closure_test: Ablations, uncertainty and distribution-shift limits are explicit.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Fluent, clinically plausible or operationally useful output cannot be assumed to be faithful or equitable.

universal.title: Participant and community governance
universal.minimum_evidence: Distinguish consultation, co-design, voting, veto, evidence-use authority, public engagement, epistemic plurality and dissent.
universal.closure_test: Governance rights are documented separately from participation or satisfaction.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Participation in research does not by itself establish governance authority.

universal.title: Equity, accessibility and affordability
universal.minimum_evidence: Assess representativeness, disability access, usability, discrimination, affordability, continuity, resource-constrained settings and benefit sharing.
universal.closure_test: Testing and access analysis cover materially affected groups and cost/dependency pathways.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: A successful selected cohort does not establish equitable access or non-discrimination.

universal.title: Accountability, oversight and remedy
universal.minimum_evidence: Map accountable actors, independent oversight, traceable decisions, complaint and challenge routes, public transparency, and regulatory/ethics coordination.
universal.closure_test: A person can identify who decides, contest the decision and obtain remedy.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Institutional approval alone does not establish operational accountability.

universal.title: Lifecycle, withdrawal and continuity
universal.minimum_evidence: Specify maintenance, support, deactivation, explantation where relevant, post-trial/post-market continuity, obsolescence, supplier exit, reversibility and reassessment triggers.
universal.closure_test: Funding, ownership, support duration and transition duties are explicit.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Short-term study support cannot be extrapolated to durable access.

universal.title: Sensitive-context and prohibited-use gates
universal.minimum_evidence: Record current applicability and future-use gates for children, education, employment, consumer use, mental health/enhancement, dual use, surveillance and social control.
universal.closure_test: Each sensitive context has an explicit reopening gate and prohibited-use analysis.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: Current research inapplicability does not erase future-use safeguards.

universal.title: Institutional capacity, monitoring and international coordination
universal.minimum_evidence: Define competent bodies, monitoring indicators, policy evaluation, environmental/supply-chain obligations and cross-jurisdiction interoperability.
universal.closure_test: The responsible institution can monitor, reassess and coordinate across borders and lifecycle changes.
universal.prohibited_if_absent: A one-time assessment cannot substitute for continuing institutional capacity.

profile_specific.title: Signal-versus-prior contribution matrix
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Ablate neural signal, motor/task labels, decoder stages, corpus constraints and language-model prior with metric deltas and residual confounds.
profile_specific.closure_test: Neural contribution is separately demonstrated; prior-only and shuffled/noise controls are reported.

profile_specific.title: Task and ground-truth boundary
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Distinguish overt action, silent speech, attempted movement, inner speech, constrained prompts, known targets and naturalistic use.
profile_specific.closure_test: Every endpoint declares the task state and ground-truth source.

profile_specific.title: Generative fidelity and hallucination analysis
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Measure verbatim accuracy, semantic similarity, fluent-but-wrong outputs, calibration and abstention.
profile_specific.closure_test: Faithfulness and plausibility are separately quantified.

profile_specific.title: Latency and output-availability class
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Classify causal, incremental, asynchronous, batch and end-to-end latency.
profile_specific.closure_test: No real-time claim exists without a controlled latency definition and measurement.

profile_specific.title: Participant and session dependence
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Report participant-specific training, calibration, session drift and cross-participant transfer.
profile_specific.closure_test: Generalization claims are bounded to tested participants and sessions.

profile_specific.title: Distribution-shift testing
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Test unseen sentences, vocabulary, topics, recording days, devices and naturalistic conditions.
profile_specific.closure_test: Out-of-distribution limits are measured and reported.

profile_specific.title: Mental-state claim boundary
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Pre-register prohibited inferences concerning unrestricted thought reading, private inner speech and latent mental-state detection.
profile_specific.closure_test: Public claims remain within the exact observed task and signal state.

profile_specific.title: Paper-code-data-checkpoint reconciliation
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Map reported configuration to released code, dataset, checkpoints and environment.
profile_specific.closure_test: Independent reproduction claims match the exact released assets.

profile_specific.title: Authorization and deployed-build graph
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Link legal authorization, labeling, supplement, device, firmware, clinician software, patient software and site build.
profile_specific.closure_test: The deployed configuration is proven to fall within the exact authorization.

profile_specific.title: Control-law specification
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Document sensed biomarker, thresholds, control states, amplitude bounds, timing, clinician authority and prohibited configurations.
profile_specific.closure_test: The controller cannot operate outside declared and tested bounds.

profile_specific.title: Fallback, override and emergency semantics
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Separate pause-to-fixed therapy, stop stimulation, clinician override, patient control and emergency recovery.
profile_specific.closure_test: Every failure state has a safe, testable transition.

profile_specific.title: Protocol and endpoint versioning
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Link protocol-defined, amended, post-hoc, sensitivity and publication endpoints.
profile_specific.closure_test: Regulatory and publication conclusions identify the exact endpoint state.

profile_specific.title: Denominator transition ledger
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Track enrollment, setup, exclusions, analysis sets, completers, preference, follow-up and exposure denominators.
profile_specific.closure_test: No denominator is silently substituted for another.

profile_specific.title: Safety and setup-burden dossier
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Record adverse events, device effects, reprogramming, pauses, visits, caregiver/travel burden and comparative safety.
profile_specific.closure_test: Benefit-risk includes operational burden and exposure-specific event denominators.

profile_specific.title: Biomarker and adaptation robustness
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Test signal availability, drift, artefact, medication/context effects and failure detection.
profile_specific.closure_test: Adaptation remains safe under tested distribution shifts.

profile_specific.title: Software change and rollback evidence
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Provide change history, verification, cybersecurity review, rollback and field recovery for every build.
profile_specific.closure_test: Current-build claims are not inferred from an older authorization baseline.

profile_specific.title: Postmarket denominator and vigilance
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Link complaints, MDRs, recalls and annual reports to model, build and exposure denominators.
profile_specific.closure_test: Postmarket incidence is stated only with a valid denominator.

profile_specific.title: Patient selection and consent evolution
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Document inclusion/exclusion, setup intolerance, preference, dynamic consent and authority over adaptive versus fixed therapy.
profile_specific.closure_test: Selected-cohort benefit is not generalized to all labeled patients.

profile_specific.title: Configuration-epoch register
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Link implant state, decoder, UI, operating system, accessories, model and support arrangements to dated epochs.
profile_specific.closure_test: Every endpoint and use claim points to an exact epoch.

profile_specific.title: Multi-axis independence profile
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Measure researcher presence, care-partner setup, daily-use autonomy, maintenance, recovery, transport and sponsor dependence.
profile_specific.closure_test: Independent use is stated on each axis, not as one binary label.

profile_specific.title: Longitudinal use and downtime ledger
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Record use days, hours, failed sessions, downtime, recovery and reasons for non-use.
profile_specific.closure_test: Availability and reliance are measured over the full observation period.

profile_specific.title: Performance-class separation
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Separate prompted ground-truth tasks, participant-rated naturalistic use, correction-dependent output and functional outcomes.
profile_specific.closure_test: No participant-rated or corrected metric is presented as independent ground-truth accuracy.

profile_specific.title: Implant and signal-integrity evidence
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Track active electrodes, signal changes, pedestal/connector state, infection, device wear, explantation and adverse events.
profile_specific.closure_test: Performance continuity cannot substitute for implant safety.

profile_specific.title: Calibration, retraining and update lineage
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Link each model update to training data, consent, privacy mode, performance change, rollback and failure recovery.
profile_specific.closure_test: Continuous learning remains auditable and withdrawable.

profile_specific.title: Human-support and caregiver burden
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Measure setup time, training, error recovery, caregiver workload and contingency arrangements.
profile_specific.closure_test: Home-use feasibility includes support burden.

profile_specific.title: Participant authority and co-design
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Separate consultation, feature requests, co-design, veto, data-use authority, privacy controls and dissent.
profile_specific.closure_test: Co-design is not treated as formal governance unless authority is documented.

profile_specific.title: Post-trial continuity and dependency accrual
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Assess essential reliance, sponsor cessation, maintenance funding, replacement, explantation and transition.
profile_specific.closure_test: Longitudinal benefit triggers stronger continuity obligations.

profile_specific.title: Trial-wide safety separation
profile_specific.minimum_evidence: Maintain participant-specific capability records separately from registered trial safety endpoints and denominators.
profile_specific.closure_test: A single-participant success cannot establish trial-wide safety.
